rationale: Fire damage to the policyholder's own kitchen cabinets and interior surfaces (ceiling/walls) is direct property damage to the insured home.
claim_summary: Fire damage claim (POL-1001) from grease flare-up on stovetop in kitchen. Charred cabinets above stove and smoke damage to ceiling and walls, no injuries. Estimated severity medium; damage localized to kitchen only. Policy limit $250k, deductible $500.

case_facts.description: grease fire from stovetop sauteing onions, extinguished with fire extinguisher
case_facts.damage_scope: charred kitchen cabinets above stove, smoke damage on ceiling and walls, no damage to rest of house

rationale: The damage stems from the policyholder's own plumbing system (burst supply line under upstairs bathroom sink), causing water damage to the basement structure and contents—a classic property_damage claim.
claim_summary: Policyholder Sam Patel discovered extensive basement flooding caused by a burst supply line under the upstairs bathroom sink that ran for approximately two days while the policyholder was away on a work trip. Damage includes two inches of standing water throughout the basement, buckled hardwood flooring, drywall saturation up to one foot, and ruined stored boxes. This is a high-severity property_damage claim requiring urgent on-site assessment and water mitigation.

case_facts.description: two inches of water across basement, hardwood floor buckled, drywall soaked up to one foot, stored boxes ruined
case_facts.water_source: burst supply line under upstairs bathroom sink, running for approximately two days

rationale: Wind damage to the policyholder's own roof structure (shingles blown off the overhang) with no water intrusion or third-party involvement is classic property damage to their own real property.
claim_summary: Wind damage to back porch overhang; four shingles blown off in windstorm last weekend. Estimated repair cost $400, no water intrusion or other damage. Low-severity property damage claim ready for roofing assessment and repair authorization.

case_facts.description: wind blew four shingles off overhang, no water damage or other damage
